Next year I will go back to Da Nang.

quite okay
Oct 2026 • Friends
The design of the restaurant is very beautiful, spacious, airy, and clean.
The food comes out quickly, delicious, and rich in flavor.
Enthusiastic and cute staff.
The price is worth the experience in my opinion.
You can have breakfast here (not every place has breakfast). The breakfast was quite delicious.
Edit: I'll come back tonight for dinner. The atmosphere is still very good. The servers are also gentle. However, the dinner was only average. Should deduct 1 point for the food, which is 4/5, while the service and atmosphere are still 5/5.
